_doc: Declarative manifest for setup/scripts/state_freshness_audit.py -- every state file the LIVE DECISION PATH reads, with the freshness contract its producer owes it. Seeded 2026-07-30 from the sibling audit of the blind-engine incident (Gamma_LevelRefresh disabled -> key-levels.json frozen at 2026-07-29 -> levels_active==[] on 386/386 safe ticks -> engine silently switched to its worst cohort). ADD A ROW whenever a new producer/consumer pair lands on the decision path.

_fields.path: repo-relative path to the state file
_fields.task: the Windows scheduled task that fires the writer (or 'manual' / 'n/a')
_fields.consumer: who READS it on the decision path, and what happens when it is stale
_fields.criticality: critical|high|medium|low|info -- drives whether staleness reports RED or YELLOW
_fields.max_age_min: wall-clock age budget, enforced ONLY while window_et is open; null = no age contract
_fields.date_field: dotted key holding the session stamp; compared against the expected session date and NOT market-hours suppressed; null = no date contract
_fields.date_expected_after_et: HH:MM after which the file must carry TODAY's session date (default 09:35)
_fields.window_et: [start,end] wall-clock window in which the producer is on duty; null = 24/7
_fields.weekdays_only: true if the producer only runs on session days

entries.consumer: heartbeat_core._read_levels -> levels_active/multi_day_levels -> filters.py detect_level_rejection. SILENT DEGRADE: every level carries expires_at, _level_expired drops the whole set on a date rollover, the read returns ([],[]) and the engine falls through to trendline-only entries (-$15/trade cohort) instead of halting. THE 2026-07-30 INCIDENT.

merged into key-levels.json by refresh_levels_intraday (level_memory_live_merge, G11) + confluence_producer. SILENT DEGRADE: the multi-day memory levels simply stop appearing in the live set; no consumer distinguishes 'no memory levels today' from 'producer dead'.

setup_dispatch gap_and_go prior_close resolution (second source after today-bias.json). SILENT DEGRADE: a stale prior close silently mis-measures the gap, so gap_and_go arms/disarms on yesterday's reference.
setup_dispatch gap_and_go prior_close (primary source); premarket bias surfaces. SILENT DEGRADE: yesterday's bias/prior_close reads as today's.

heartbeat_core._read_context_bundle. CORRECT DEGRADE (the reference implementation): >20 min old -> returns None and the tick LOGS an absent bundle. Currently log-only, so blast radius is analysis quality, not entries -- but it is the model the level read should have followed.

SHADOW today (dashboard/self_check/confluence_producer) -- the engine's trendline_rejection trigger is computed in-engine from the bar window, NOT from this file. SILENT DEGRADE: confluence zones get built from yesterday's lines with no marker.

dashboard + level ranking. SILENT DEGRADE + COMPOUNDING: it reads three shadow files (key-levels-memory / trendlines-live / prior-rth-close) and emits a plausible-looking zone set even when all three inputs are a day old.
fleet_live -> every enabled fleet arm's entry decision. Has a REAL stale guard (_decision_is_blind, 6 min) plus a sight-beacon fallback, so it degrades LOUDLY. Listed to keep the contract visible.

build_shared_signal._fresh_beacon (the NEVER-BLIND fallback eye). Has a 180s freshness guard -> degrades correctly. Age axis already covered by engine_health.check_sight_beacon; the date axis here is the addition.
heartbeat_core kill-switch + start-of-day equity anchor for Rule 5. SILENT DEGRADE: a stale last_reset means the daily-loss budget is measured against a PRIOR day's equity.
heartbeat_core kill-switch + start-of-day equity anchor for the Bold account.

build_shared_signal (fleet perception), engine_health, every replay/audit harness. Age axis already covered by engine_health.check_engine_core; the date axis catches a ledger that stopped mid-session.
daily_brief + J's 'did it trade today' surface (OP-33e). SILENT DEGRADE: a stale file makes yesterday's fills read as today's, or an active day read as idle.
firm_brief, fill_funnel, fleet_journal_bridge, trade_autopsy -- the C1 real-fills authority. SILENT DEGRADE: every downstream P&L/WR claim quietly reports a stale book as current.
J's morning go/no-go surface -- and it carries the levels_sanity check that was BUILT to catch exactly the 2026-07-30 outage. SILENT DEGRADE: the gate not running looks identical to the gate passing.
patches today-bias.json key_levels EMA fields (premarket TradingView read is primary, this is the fallback/pre-seeder). SILENT DEGRADE: stale EMAs seed the bias silently.
premarket news-freshness gate (FOMC/CPI/NFP). SILENT DEGRADE: a stale calendar reads as 'no events today'.

the liveness alarm for the autonomous futures lane. SILENT DEGRADE: the tick writes this beacon on EVERY fire including HOLDs, so a stale file is the ONLY way to distinguish 'quiet market' from 'lane is dead'. Wired on day one deliberately -- the crypto twin once went dark 4 days unnoticed because nothing was watching a producer that only spoke when it traded.

futures_risk_rails.check_data_freshness -- ONLY a GREEN verdict authorizes a futures entry. SILENT DEGRADE: a stale snapshot pins the last verdict, so a dead yfinance feed could read GREEN forever and authorize entries on two-month-old bars. That exact staleness (the MES master ended 2026-06-12) is why the live spine exists at all.
